Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare

 c_usps_id donor_addresses.usps_id%type;
 c_dob donors.date_of_birth%type;
 chk_all number :=0;
 v_date date;
begin
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 if :global.action='CANCEL' then
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;


 :ctrl_blk.donor_id := :global.donor_id;
 

 /* populate name,date of birth , ssn ,sex*/

 select ltrim(rtrim(last_name))||', '||ltrim(rtrim(first_name))||' '||
 ltrim(rtrim(middle_name)),
 date_of_birth,
 decode(gender,'M','Male','F','Female')
 into :ctrl_blk.name,
 c_dob,
 :ctrl_blk.sex
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 
 
 :ctrl_blk.date_of_birth := to_char(c_dob,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 

 /* populate street , suite/apartment */
 begin
 select NVL(street_name, '-'),
 NVL(suite_apt, '-'),
 usps_id,
 REPLACE(
 intl_address_1||', '||
 NVL(intl_address_2,'#@#')||', '||
 NVL(intl_address_3,'#@#')||', '||
 NVL(intl_address_4,'#@#')||', '||
 country_name||', '||
 NVL(intl_postal_code,'#@#'),
 ', #@#'
 ,'') , -- International Address Change
 intl_addr_flag -- International Address Change
 into :ctrl_blk.street_name,
 :ctrl_blk.suite_apt,
 c_usps_id, 
 :ctrl_blk.intl_addr, -- International Address Change
 :ctrl_blk.intl_addr_flag -- International Address Change
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id;
 
 /*-- International Address Change */
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11212'); /* No address available */
 when others then
 
 handle_error;
 end;

 /* populate city,state,zip */
 IF NVL(:ctrl_blk.intl_addr_flag,'N') = 'N' 
 THEN
 begin
 select zip,
 city,
 state
 into :ctrl_blk.zip,
 :ctrl_blk.city,
 :ctrl_blk.state
 from valid_city_state
 where usps_id = c_usps_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18032'); /* City address is not maintained */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
 :ctrl_blk.intl_addr := NULL; -- IM 721
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk.zip := '-';
 :ctrl_blk.city := '-';
 :ctrl_blk.state := '-';
 END IF; 
 /* Check whether has access to ALL , if so assign 0 to other properties */ 
 
 begin
 select distinct 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR'
 and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1)
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all = 1 then
 :ctrl_blk.other_propr :=0;
 else
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl_blk.other_propr
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR'
 and access_class in
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1))
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1) )
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_date+1);
 exception
 when others then
 
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if; 

 /* poplate existing interdictions and go to new_inter_blk to 
 enable the user to enter new interdictions */

 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 execute_query;
 go_block('new_inter_blk');
Exception when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
--message('before check in new block');
declare
 descr varchar2(50);
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_term_date date;
 cursor c1 (v_date date) is
 select inter_code,
 inter_type,
 eff_date,
 term_date,
 insert_user,
 release_user
 from donor_interdictions
 where donor_id = :ctrl_blk.donor_id
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='PROPR')
 and term_date<v_date
 order by eff_date desc ;
 v_date1 date;
 
begin
 v_date1 := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 /* set insert allowed * delete allowed properties true to enable to
 insert the data */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_block('term_inter_blk');

 /* populate the block with terminated interdicions */

 for z in c1 (v_date1)
 loop
 begin
 select inter_desc
 into descr
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=z.inter_code;
 
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(SYSDATE,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 
 v_local_term_date := trunc(to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'mm-dd-yyyy HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI'));
 
 else
 v_local_term_date :=to_date(to_char(SYSDATE,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;

 :term_inter_blk.inter_code := z.inter_code;
 :term_inter_blk.descrip := descr;
 :term_inter_blk.eff_date := z.eff_date; --to_char(z.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'); -- jairam commented
 --:term_inter_blk.term_date := v_local_term_date;-- z.term_date; --to_char(z.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'); --jairam commntd -- Commented by Kishore on 11/05/2014. IM 10229
 :term_inter_blk.term_date := z.term_date; -- Added by Kishore on 11/05/2014. IM 10229
 :term_inter_blk.insert_user := z.insert_user;
 :term_inter_blk.release_user := z.release_user;
 next_record;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 descr := z.inter_code || '-No description found';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end loop;

 /* delete the blank record created at the end of the block */

 delete_record;
 first_record; 

 /* set the insert allowed and delete allowed properties to false */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

end;

PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, 
 no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, 
 f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name 
 and field_name = field_name1;

END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_VALID_PROPR

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 c_status varchar2(250):= 'OK';
 szChapter varchar2(5);
begin
 If IS_MULTI_CHAPTER then
 szChapter:='ALL';
 Else
 szChapter:=:global.chapter_id;
 End If; 
 
 :system.message_level :=25;
 go_block('new_inter_blk');
 first_record;
 loop 
 if :new_inter_blk.inter_code is not null then
 begin 
 don_inter.inter_upgrade_place(:ctrl_blk.donor_id,
 szChapter,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :new_inter_blk.inter_code,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.user_id,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :banner.prog_name,
 trunc(:new_inter_blk.eff_date),
 :new_inter_blk.term_date,
 NULL,
 c_status) ;
 
 if c_status!='OK' then
 message('Error:'||c_status);
 pause;
 else
 update donor_interdictions set term_date=nvl(term_date,:new_inter_blk.term_date) where
 donor_id=:ctrl_blk.donor_id and inter_code=:new_inter_blk.inter_code and eff_date=:new_inter_blk.eff_date and
 program_id='DPIPLPRP'; 
 end if;

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end;
 else
 show_error('18066');
 check_package_failure; -- Added by Kishore on 03/29/2013. SCR 17716
 end if;
 end loop; 
 commit;
 :system.message_level := '10';
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 03/29/2013. SCR 17716
 -- Moved code from KEY-COMMIT trigger
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');

 execute_query;

 clear_block;
 -- End of change
